pack.topic: Vertical Lightwell & Courtyard Structural Framing for Compact Coimbatore Urban Plots
pack.source_script_insight: Adapting traditional regional courtyard layouts (Manduva typology) into compact modern urban plots requires converting horizontal courtyards into multi-level vertical lightwells, demanding precise beam perimeter framing and base planter waterproofing.
pack.coimbatore_angle: In fast-growing Coimbatore residential hubs like Peelamedu, Vadavalli, and Saravanampatti where plot widths are tight, building a vertical central courtyard provides natural cross-ventilation and daylighting without sacrificing floor area.
pack.core_takeaway: When incorporating a vertical courtyard lightwell on compact Coimbatore plots, ensure continuous perimeter structural beams around the slab cutout and execute double-layer waterproofing with subsurface drainage at the base.

pack.title_english: Vertical Courtyard Structural Framing for Compact Coimbatore Homes
pack.caption_english:
Building on tight urban plots in Peelamedu, Vadavalli, or Saravanampatti doesn't mean sacrificing natural daylight and cross-ventilation. Reimagining traditional courtyard layouts into a vertical multi-level lightwell brings daylight deep into your home. However, proper execution requires strict perimeter beam framing around slab cutouts and two-layer waterproofing with subsurface drainage at the base planter to avoid moisture seepage. Build smart with engineered site practices.

Planning your dream home in Coimbatore? Contact OliveTree Builders today for turnkey engineering excellence!

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
OliveTree Builders present COIMBATORE ONLY residential construction video guide. EXACTLY 10 SECONDS total duration, split into EXACTLY 7 SCENES in portrait 9:16 aspect ratio. MUST BE 90%+ PHOTOREALISTIC LIVE-ACTION-STYLE REAL FOOTAGE recorded on raw smartphone/gimbal cameras. Strictly NO 2D/3D cartoon animation, NO flat infographics, NO fake CGI cities, NO glossy floating elements. All scenes take place on active residential construction sites in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, showing authentic Indian site conditions, concrete textures, rebar, red bricks, clay terracotta tiles, daylighting, and Tamil construction workers in safety gear.

SCENE BREAKDOWN (Exact Timestamps):

SCENE 1 (0.0s - 1.4s): Low-angle shot looking directly up through a square 6ftx6ft slab cutout inside an under-construction house in Vadavalli, Coimbatore. Sharp morning sunlight streams down into the room. Concrete ceiling edges are visible with raw shuttering marks. Foreground: dark interior wall contrast. Small text overlay in bottom corner: 'உள் முற்றம்?'.

SCENE 2 (1.4s - 2.8s): Close-up shot at slab level during reinforcement steel laying. TMT steel bars bound tightly into perimeter beams surrounding a lightwell cutout opening. Clear wire ties, concrete cover blocks, and wooden shuttering boards visible. Text overlay: 'Beam Perimeter Framing'.

SCENE 3 (2.8s - 4.2s): Eye-level medium shot of an experienced Tamil mason inspecting shuttering plate edges lined around the multi-level vertical courtyard cutout on the first-floor slab. Masons wearing yellow helmet and reflective vest. Text overlay: 'Slab Opening Cutout'.

SCENE 4 (4.2s - 5.6s): High-angle action shot inside the ground-floor sunken planter pit beneath the lightwell. Worker applying a thick black elastomeric waterproof membrane onto the smooth cement plaster pit walls using a wide roller brush. Wet glossy texture visible. Text overlay: 'Planter Waterproofing'.

SCENE 5 (5.6s - 7.0s): Macro close-up on a black corrugated perforated drain pipe wrapped in geotextile fabric laid inside a gravel drainage layer at the base of the indoor courtyard pit. Natural daylight falls from top. Text overlay: 'Subsurface Drainage'.

SCENE 6 (7.0s - 8.5s): Smooth gimbal forward tracking shot through a corridor. Sunlight floods down from the central vertical core onto white plastered brick walls and red terracotta jaali lattice ventilation blocks. Real Tamil Nadu home interior under construction finish. Text overlay: 'Natural Air Flow'.

SCENE 7 (8.5s - 10.0s): Wide final shot of a completed modern residence living room in Coimbatore. Lush green indoor ficus planter in the central ground floor courtyard directly beneath the double-height vertical lightwell core. Sunlight fills the living room. Clean overlay graphics at bottom: 'OliveTree Builders Quality'.

CONTINUITY & STYLE RULES: Strict physical continuity across all scenes. Realistic Indian site elements, authentic sun angles, realistic concrete, rebar, brick, and waterproofing material textures. Natural motion graphics overlays only (small clean text tags, subtle line highlights). Lens feel: 24mm to 35mm handheld/gimbal footage with natural depth of field.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: No cartoon, 2D vector graphic, flat screen explainer, plastic rendering, 3D architecture software animation, floating fake text blocks, unrealistically clean CGI, non-Indian workers, foreign urban backdrop, landscape format, black side pillars, studio lighting, exaggerated visual effects.
